verdict.rationale: Databricks ships Genie Code, a built-in AI assistant in the workspace. Users can delegate agentic tasks to it: it plans, runs code, fixes errors and asks for approval before using tools. It also generates and runs code, builds pipelines and dashboards, and can run multiple chats in parallel. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Genie Code's agentic delegation quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Run Genie Code as an autonomous agent that plans, runs code, fixes errors, and asks for approval before it uses tools.
Chat with Genie Code, get inline suggestions, and run agentic tasks in your workspace.
It generates and runs code, builds pipelines and AI/BI dashboards, debugs errors, and works directly with Unity Catalog tables, columns, and lineage to accelerate multi-step data work.
Start work directly from Genie Code rather than from an asset like a notebook, run multiple chats in parallel
